sources.snippet:
The Write Practice strives to convince their readers why learning to write better is important to them and their lives. Their method is to talk about the question “why?” a lot; they believe that if a student is convinced that what they’re learning is important to them, then they will always learn better. They also believe deeply in deliberate practice, and that’s why at the end of each lesson, they give students a chance to put what they’ve just learned to use immediately, encouraging them to [...] Creative Writing Resources by TeacherVision
